name: @glot/runtime
description: Long-tail locales at zero cost: on-device UI translation (Chrome Translator API) with glot's guarantees — masked placeholders, glossary, plural structure, WASM validation, source fallback.

scripts.build:wasm: cd ../.. && CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO=true CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_OPT_LEVEL=z CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_CODEGEN_UNITS=1 CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_PANIC=abort CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_STRIP=true cargo build -p glot-wasm --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && mkdir -p packages/runtime/dist && cp ${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-target}/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/glot_wasm.wasm packages/runtime/dist/glot.wasm
scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --minify --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/index.js && esbuild src/next-intl.ts src/i18next.ts --bundle --format=esm --minify --target=es2022 --external:react --external:next-intl --external:./index.js --outdir=dist && tsc
